news.title: Summer 4-week boot camp
news.body: Fun Club's four-week summer program helped young English learners develop confidence in speaking through engaging lessons, storytelling, drawing, interactive games, and real-life communication activities. Students practiced everyday English while strengthening creativity, social skills, and classroom participation in a fun and supportive environment.

news.title: Spring session wraps with a family showcase
news.body: Students shared short stories, songs, and vocabulary games with families in a packed community virtual-room afternoon.

news.title: 1,000 service hours and counting
news.body: Our student volunteers and members just crossed a thousand logged hours mentoring, planning lessons, and running weekend workshops.

programs.title: English Learning
programs.body: Weekly small-group sessions covering conversation, reading, writing, and vocabulary. Every lesson uses games, flashcards, and role play so children practice English in a low-pressure, encouraging setting.

programs.title: Leadership Development
programs.body: Older students step into leadership by planning lessons, leading discussions, and mentoring newer members. Volunteers build communication, organization, and public-speaking skills through real responsibility.

programs.title: STEM Projects
programs.body: Hands-on science and technology workshops — from simple circuits to coding basics — paired with the English vocabulary students need to describe what they are building.

programs.title: Learning Toolkit
programs.body: Our Learning Toolkit provides free, research-informed resources that help students develop stronger study habits, organization, focus, memory, and executive functioning skills. Inspired by neuroscience and learning science, these practical tools are designed to support a wide range of learners and help every student build confidence both inside and outside the classroom.
